description: This is a PHP class file for the 'SugarApplication' class, which manages the core application logic for SuiteCRM, including session management, user authentication, language loading, resource setup, and request routing.

classes.name: SugarApplication
classes.description: Main application class handling session, authentication, routing, and configuration for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main execution flow of the application, initializing modules, handling user sessions, and routing requests.

methods.name: loadUser
methods.description: Loads and authenticates the current user, setting global user context and managing session security.

methods.name: ACLFilter
methods.description: Applies Access Control List filtering to the module list based on user permissions.

methods.name: setupResourceManagement
methods.description: Initializes resource management specific to the current module.

methods.name: setupPrint
methods.description: Prepares the request string for printing and debugging.

methods.name: preProcess
methods.description: Performs pre-processing tasks before executing the main controller actions, such as loading language and configuration settings.

methods.name: handleOfflineClient
methods.description: Implements logic for offline or disconnected client scenarios.

methods.name: handleAccessControl
methods.description: Manages user permissions and module access restrictions.

methods.name: preLoadLanguages
methods.description: Loads minimal language data necessary before full language initialization.

methods.name: loadLanguages
methods.description: Loads all necessary language strings for the current user and module.

methods.name: checkDatabaseVersion
methods.description: Verifies that the database version matches the application's expected version and halts if not.

methods.name: loadDisplaySettings
methods.description: Loads user display preferences such as themes and UI settings.

methods.name: loadLicense
methods.description: Loads licensing information for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadGlobals
methods.description: Sets global variables based on the current module and request.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a PHP session, managing session IDs and expiry.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Destroys the current PHP session.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to a specified URL, with support for AJAX and headers sent situations.

methods.name: headerRedirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect based on a header string, parsing 'Location' headers.

methods.name: appendErrorMessage
methods.description: Adds an error message to the user message queue.

methods.name: getErrorMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored error messages.

methods.name: appendSuccessMessage
methods.description: Adds a success message to the user message queue.

methods.name: getSuccessMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored success messages.

methods.name: appendMessage
methods.description: Stores a message of a specific type in session.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored messages of a specific type from session.

methods.name: validateMessageType
methods.description: Validates message type for session message storage.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Wrapper around PHP's setcookie(), managing headers already sent situation and domain/path defaults.

methods.name: createLoginVars
methods.description: Builds a query string with parameters to preserve login state and post-login redirection.

methods.name: getLoginVars
methods.description: Returns an array of login-related variables passed in the request.

methods.name: getLoginRedirect
methods.description: Constructs URL for redirecting after login, preserving login context.
